newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-ACCC to look at Advance-St George merger.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-ACCC to look at Advance-St George merger.

text.p: Anti-monopolies watchdog the Australian Competition and Consumer Commission (ACCC) said on Monday it would examine the proposed merger of regional banks Advance Bank Ltd and St George Bank Ltd.
"We'll have a look at it," an ACCC spokeswoman told Reuters.
"We judge these things on a case by case basis," she said.
ACCC chairman Allan Fels has said he would be especially concerned if bank mergers left any state banking market without one regional bank.
St George Bank and Advance Bank are both New South Wales-based banks.
If St George and Advance merge, there would be two reigional banks in New South Wales.
The former State Bank of New South Wales is currently operating as Colonial State Bank as part of the Colonial Mutual Group.
